summary: John's great-aunt, the younger sister of his grandfather James C. Meier; born in Wilkes-Barre in 1935, she died in 2021 as Barbara Ann Meier Smith.
bio: Barbara Ann Meier was born in Wilkes-Barre, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, on 17 November 1935, the younger sister of John's grandfather James C. Meier. Known in later life as Barbara Ann Meier Smith, she died on 16 September 2021 and was buried at Jesus Bread of Life Catholic Cemetery in Mount Laurel, New Jersey.
